$comment: The repo's GitHub social preview, rendered BY the pipeline it advertises. Regenerate: bash scripts/render.sh assets/social-preview.config.json social-preview /tmp/sp   (then copy /tmp/sp/social-preview-slides/slide-1.png over assets/social-preview.png). 1280x640 is GitHub's recommended card size.

slides.headline: Ship-ready social visuals *on your own brand*
slides.subhead: PNG cards, PDF carousels, looping MP4 + GIF. Every render passes a deterministic QA gate, a claims ledger and a blind checksummed review loop before it leaves the machine.
